recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, outdoor photograph of three men in late 1960s/early 1970s attire positioned around a large, dark-barked tree in a sun-dappled park. The scene is characterized by a high-key, slightly hazy atmosphere with dominant greens and browns, topped with bold, white serif typography that curves slightly to follow the canopy line.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject group anchored to the verticality of the large tree trunk
Text following the organic curve of the upper foliage
Foreground grass blurred to create depth of field
Contrast between dark tree bark and bright white clothing/text
coreInvariants: Desaturated green and earthy brown palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are positioned in the left-middle ground, occupying approximately one-third of the horizontal frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark tree trunk acts as the primary vertical anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the bold white title at the top, follows the tree trunk down to the seated figure, and then moves across the grassy field to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right quadrant filled with blurred foliage and light.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted forest green and sage (background foliage and grass)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep umber and charcoal (tree bark and clothing shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high brightness; the image has a 'washed out' vintage film quality.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Slight baseline arching for the primary title line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold Roman serif paired with its Italic counterpart for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vintage weight and character.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus photograph of three men in 1970s casual attire (vests, bell-bottoms) standing and sitting around a massive dark tree trunk in a sunlit, hazy park. The foreground grass is blurred. The lighting is warm and diffused.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold white serif text at the top, arched slightly to match the tree canopy. Use a secondary line of italicized serif text in all caps directly below it.

verificationChecks: Is the text white and legible against the green background?
Does the photography have a soft, vintage film grain?
Is the tree trunk the primary vertical element?
Are the subjects dressed in period-appropriate 1970s clothing?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects
Specific song titles listed in small print

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subjects and negative space

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'glow' or 'halation' around bright highlights
Ensure the white trousers don't blow out the exposure
Verify the text feels integrated into the scene rather than just pasted on top
Confirm the color palette remains within earthy greens and browns
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Park Scene + Large Anchor Tree + Soft Focus Film Grain + Arched Bold Serif Typography = 1970s Folk Aesthetic
